theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∀ (Vs : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (As : (k : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Vs k) n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℕ, ∃ (k₀ : ℕ) (Γ : ℝ≥0∞), Γ ≠ ∞ ∧ A.massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → ball (0 : Euclid P) ((R : ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Vs k ∧ (As k).massOn (ball 0 ((R : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Γ) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k => currentEval (As k) ((ωs m : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop (𝓝 (A (ωs m)))) → ConvergesWeakly As A
